target.title: fix(media): normalizeMediaSource should handle uppercase FILE:// URI schemes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`MEDIA:` directives using an uppercase `FILE://` URI scheme are left in assistant text instead of being extracted as local media attachments. Per RFC 3986, URI schemes are case-insensitive, so `MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/generated.png` should produce the same result as `MEDIA:file:///tmp/generated.png`.

Issue: #103473

## Why This Change Was Made

`normalizeMediaSource` only matched lowercase `file://` via `String.startsWith`, so uppercase and mixed-case schemes were not recognized. The remaining scheme-shaped value failed local-path validation and the directive stayed in visible output text.

## User Impact

When an assistant or tool output emits a valid file URI with non-lowercase scheme spelling, the intended local media attachment is silently not delivered and the raw directive remains in the reply. The fix makes extraction case-insensitive—no behavioral change for the common lowercase case.

## Evidence

- 59/59 tests pass (2 new cases added for uppercase `FILE://` and lowercase `file://`)
- `normalizeMediaSource("FILE:///tmp/generated.png")` now returns `/tmp/generated.png` instead of `FILE:///tmp/generated.png`
- Existing lowercase `file://` behavior unchanged
